notes.quote: I've worked with many talented people, but Julia stands out as the best product designer I've ever had the chance to collaborate with. … Julia didn't just elevate our product - she raised the bar for the entire tech org.
notes.snippet: Raised the bar for the entire tech org
notes.name: Valentina Lopes Costa

notes.quote: Júlia is an exceptionally talented designer that understands users, technology, and design. Her energy and can-do attitude are contagious and helped us ship many products and features. … Go Júlia!!
notes.name: Nicolau Monteiro

notes.quote: Julia is an incredible, attentive professional. I’ve had the chance to do a few mentoring sessions with her, and to me she’s the best mentor on the platform.
notes.snippet: The best mentor on the platform
notes.name: Diogo R.

notes.quote: Júlia has a great heart. She is so kind as a person and you can feel it in her professional advice too. She can help you, point out things that you need to improve and teach important lessons. All this with a lot of empathy and kindness.
notes.snippet: All this with a lot of empathy and kindness
notes.name: Luiza G.

notes.quote: Julia seems genuinely preoccupied with finding the best way to help. At the end of our session she provided me a personalized resource full of indications and tips, which really was above my expectations.
notes.snippet: A personalized resource full of tips
notes.name: Joana G.

notes.quote: I love the guidance Júlia gives. She’s very smart, experienced and great at explaining! I’m so grateful for her help in growing my career. Highly recommend!
notes.snippet: Smart, experienced and great at explaining
notes.name: Jéssica K.

notes.quote: I’ve only just completed my first session with Julia and I’m excited for the next one. Julia was empathetic and encouraging and gave actionable steps to take.
notes.name: Ariyike A.

notes.quote: The session with Júlia was great. I felt completely at ease asking my questions, and she gave me plenty of material that will help me a lot to improve my portfolio. She’s very transparent and attentive to detail, and shows incredible dedication from the start of the session to the end.
notes.name: Ryan C.

lines: From people I’ve worked with and designers I’ve mentored.
